notes: Armory Avenue printed 'ARMORY AV. (EVERETT)'. John Street and Central Avenue run NNW-SSE across the sheet; both continue north of Liberty (Vol 3). Gamble Alley is three pieces: a 15' near-vertical strip Liberty-Bauer (x ~2030), then a diagonal 10'6" alley Bauer-Wade starting 128 px further east, interrupted by block 6, then a 16' diagonal Gamble Alley David-Armory collinear with the Bauer-Wade piece. Earl Alley (Bauer-Wade) and Bard Alley (David-Armory) are collinear across block 6. Between Cutter and John, Wade is an 'OPEN MARKET SPACE' from the park block (south line y ~1837) to block 5 (north line y ~2255); Wade points use the Wade centreline from sheet 81. David jogs about 50 px (17 ft) south at John, so two T points. Wade doglegs at Central: the east leg (named Wade on sheet 83) is offset ~15 ft north and runs ENE, so two T points. The ENE street east of Central below Armory is named '?': its only label is a partly legible 'W.15TH'(?) on the water main.
